prompt: One adorable baby coati, full body, isolated white background. Huge rounded head, enormous glossy eyes, compact chubby body, beautifully sculpted matte fluffy fur. Brown fur, cream muzzle, long nose, ringed tail. Original polished 3D game pet, relaxed seated pose, soft studio lighting.
negative_prompt: multiple animals, collage, text, watermark, clothes, plastic, human, extra limbs, badly distorted anatomy, deformed eyes, small eyes, cropped body, scenery
style_conditioning: Text conditioning only; references used for mandatory visual comparison.
acceptance: Mandatory comparison with original black bear and approved Ocelot. Prioritize species identity, face, fur and proportions. Minor pose/paw issues receive Blender correction; reject collages, severe distortion and wrong species. Final mesh still needs four-view and Studio QA.
